preconditions.description: The position of the Pied Piper in the string must be within the bounds of the string.

preconditions.expression: all(char in 'PO~' for char in rats)
preconditions.description: The string contains only valid characters: 'P', 'O', and '~'.

postconditions.description: The number of deaf rats must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: result == sum(1 for i in range(piper_position) if rats[i] in 'O~' and rats[i+1] == 'P') + sum(1 for i in range(piper_position+1, len(rats)) if rats[i] in '~O' and rats[i-1] == 'P')
postconditions.description: The number of deaf rats is calculated by counting the rats to the left of the Pied Piper that are going right and the rats to the right of the Pied Piper that are going left.
